subject: Bridge still needs explicit swizzle validity + view-format sampler
body: Read current bridge: D2_OFFSET/declared span now looks correct (base_offset+declared, level_offset separate), and l.swizzle_valid=l.swizzle_word?1:0 is still a nonzero heuristic. That cannot represent explicit RRRR (valid word0) and will silently treat it as format default. The wire needs an explicit validity bit/flag (or a reserved sentinel distinct from word0); helper contract is swizzle_valid=1 + word0 for RRRR. Also at the combined sampler call, n2t_format_query(l.format,&fi) still uses allocation format; helper ClampToZero alpha/integer-border class must use l.view_format?l.view_format:l.format. I have no edit rights to the bridge. Current helper v2 plane word7 is zero for arch9; old n2r legacy word7 remains nonzero separately. Textures tests 779 release+ASan; n2r suite PASS.
